name: Serendipity
source:
Noma has just graduated from college. 
Now that he is in the real world what should he do? 
Should he pursue a career?
Or sleep in and let life and fate decide his life?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21633&p=275185]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
野間剛剛大學畢業。
如今踏入了現實世界，他該做什麼？
是追求事業？
還是睡個懶覺，把人生交給生活與命運決定？

［來自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21633&p=275185]Lemma Soft論壇[/url]］
